name: School of the Unseen
description: Jodah's school, reduced to rubble in the end.

description_citations.text: "The Shattered Alliance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The school is forced to relocate at the start of the Ice Age and settles on newly risen land.
timeline.quote: the scholars settled on new land risen from the sea, south and west from the original island of Lat-Nam.

citation.text: "School of the Unseen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerda trades Jodah to Lim-Dûl for the Bottomless Pit of Tresserhorn, giving her access to a pool of black mana.
timeline.quote: In a bid for power, she exchanged Jodah in return for the Bottomless Pit of Tresserhorn .

citation.text: "School of the Unseen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lim-Dûl is defeated; Jodah survives and returns to rule, with Gerda as his second-in-command as punishment.
timeline.quote: Lim-Dûl was defeated in Lim-Dûl's Battle , but Jodah survived his ordeal and returned to rule the school

citation.text: "School of the Unseen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Thaw and the Flooding of Terisiare lift the veil hiding the school, and its scholars help evacuate and resettle flood victims.
timeline.quote: During these critical early years they helped evacuate, rescue, and resettle those whose homes and towns were lost to the floods.

citation.text: "School of the Unseen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jodah leaves with Jaya Ballard to hunt Mairsil-Lim-Dûl's spirit, leaving Gerda in charge.
timeline.quote: Jodah left with Jaya Ballard to track down the remainder of Mairsil -Lim-Dûl's spirit and left Gerda in charge of the school.

citation.text: "School of the Unseen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Steam Beasts and War Beasts are teleported into the pit beneath the school, destroying it; Gerda kills one War Beast but cannot save it.
timeline.quote: The destruction of the school was swift and total

citation.text: "School of the Unseen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Newly ascended planeswalker Jaya Ballard stops the destruction.
timeline.quote: was only stopped in the end by the newly ascended planeswalker Jaya Ballard

citation.text: "School of the Unseen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The School of the Unseen hides after retribution on Lat-Nam.
timeline.quote: After the terrible retribution visited upon Lat-Nam, this school of mages chose to hide from the eyes of the world.

citation.text: School of the Unseen (Alliances, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jaya fails to steal from Jodah's chambers; sensing her magic he lets her study at the School of the Unseen, but she leaves to be a task mage.
timeline.quote: Sensing magical capabilities in her, Jodah allowed Jaya to study in the School of the Unseen at Lat-Nam

citation.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jaya brings Jodah Lim-Dûl's hand with the ring finger missing, and they search for the ring.
timeline.quote: Jodah and Jaya set out to search for the missing ring

citation.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "Shattered Alliance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Her planeswalker spark flares, Jaya erases Mairsil's presence and destroys the war beasts, then helps seal the pit and relocate the school.

citation.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "Shattered Alliance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Soldev, Jaya, vessel of Mairsil/Dûl, stabs Jodah, and the Adnates use his blood to activate the War Beasts, which level Soldev and the School of the Unseen.
timeline.quote: Jaya stabbed Jodah fatally, revealing that she had been the new vessel of Mairsil/Dûl all along

citation.text: "Jodah", section "Shattered Alliances". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Twenty years later Jaya shows Jodah the blackened hand of Dul, claiming to have found it in a Soldev market.
timeline.quote: She shows him the blackened hand of Dûl which she claims to have found in a market in Soldev .

citation.text: "The Shattered Alliance", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Students at the School find a cloud of black mana in the basement; Gerda recalls Lim-Dul asking her to look after his bottomless pit.
timeline.quote: twenty years ago Lim-Dûl contacted her, offering to take Jodah off her hands

citation.text: "The Shattered Alliance", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The School of the Unseen is mostly reduced to rubble; Gerda leads survivors east, Jaya leaves, and Jodah disappears from history.
timeline.quote: Jodah himself decides to disappear from the history books.

citation.text: "The Shattered Alliance", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jodah becomes Archmage and marries Sima, but outlives her and sinks into grief, storing his memories in his mirror.
timeline.quote: he began to store his memories in his mirror, wipe his memory clean, and then restore the memories from the mirror

citation.text: "Jodah", section "Archmage of the Unseen". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Archmage Eternal who oversaw the shift to the School
relations.quote: oversaw the shift from the City of Shadows to the School of the Unseen

citation.text: "Jodah", section "Archmage of the Unseen". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: It lasted millennia and was led by Jodah , Archmage Eternal.

citation.text: "School of the Unseen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
